recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Arab Republic of Egypt. Presidential republic.
rulers: President Abdel Fattah EL-SISI (since 8 June 2014); Prime Minister Mostafa MADBOULY (since 7 June 2018)
economy: Africa’s second-largest economy; 2030 Vision to diversify markets and energy infrastructure; improving fiscal, external, and current accounts; underperforming private sector; poor labor force participation; expanded credit access GDP (PPP): $1.958 trillion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Egyptian Armed Forces (EAF): Army (includes Republican Guard), Navy (includes Coast Guard), Air Force, Air Defense Forces, Border Guard Forces Interior Ministry: Public Security Sector Police, the Central Security Force, National Security Agency (2025) Expenditure: 0.7% of GDP (2024 est.)
origin: 28 February 1922 (from UK protectorate status; the military-led revolution that began on 23 July 1952 led to a republic being declared on 18 June 1953 and all British troops withdrawn on 18 June 1956)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
